gloss: to cut off; to break off; to end

definitions.gloss: to cut off; to break off; to end
definitions.explanation: To bring something to an end or cut it off completely: contact, a relationship, one's life. Mostly used in set phrases.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{絶|た}った。
⟦{登山者|とざんしゃ}→登山者：21318_tozansha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{山中|さんちゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{消息|しょうそく}→消息：19242_shousoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{絶|た}った。
examples.english: A climber went missing in the mountains.

examples.japanese: ⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦{仲間|なかま}→仲間：03498_nakama⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{絶|た}って、⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦やり{直|なお}す→やり直す：03172_yarinaosu⟧ことにした。
examples.english: I cut ties with the bad crowd and decided to start over from scratch.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{消息|しょうそく}→消息：19242_shousoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{絶|た}つ: to disappear without a trace, to go missing
- ⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{絶|た}つ: to cut off contact
- ⟦{自|みずか}ら→自ら：00287_mizukara⟧⟦{命|いのち}→命：02371_inochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{絶|た}つ: to take one's own life
- ⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{絶|た}たない: to keep happening (⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{絶|た}たない, accidents keep happening)

WRITING:
The same word is written ⟦{断|た}つ→断つ：27885_tatsu⟧ when something is cut off or given up (⟦{酒|さけ}→酒：02211_sake⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{断|た}つ→断つ：27885_tatsu⟧, {退路|たいろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{断|た}つ→断つ：27885_tatsu⟧) and {絶|た}つ when something is ended for good (⟦{消息|しょうそく}→消息：19242_shousoku⟧, ⟦{命|いのち}→命：02371_inochi⟧, ⟦{縁|えん}→縁：02182_en⟧). The line is blurry, and both spellings occur with ⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧ and ⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧. {裁|た}つ (to cut cloth) is a different word.
